name: everglade-kit
description: The licensed medieval kit pack: built from the private export by scripts/unreal/medieval_kit_build.py and compiled by the everglade_kit example, outside the repository. Only its digest and length are pinned, in everglade_pack/kit.rs; it regenerates only on a machine with the private export.
regenerate: python3 scripts/unreal/medieval_kit_build.py >&2 && cargo run --release -p verse-zone-everglade --example everglade_kit
message: Repin the Everglade kit pack with {changes}
